newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB bank launches NZ's first Internet banking site.
newsitem.headline: ASB bank launches NZ's first Internet banking site.

text.p: ASB Bank on Monday said it had become the first bank in New Zealand to launch a full Internet banking service for its customers.
Customers using "Fastnet" will be able to check account balances, transfer funds, make bill payments and print off statements from their own computers, ASB said in a statement.
A key priority during a 15-month trial of the system had been security.
"We are now totally satisfied with security on Fastnet, and we are using the latest European technology to ensure this," ASB said.
The system was developed by Christchurch-based company Cardinal Network and features 128 bit encryption.
ASB said it was also working on other Internet developments, such as secure credit card payment and purchases made on the Internet.
